digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码 Agent 按成熟工程方法论工作的技能框架，把开发流程沉淀为可复用技能

repos.name: affaan-m/ECC
repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencod
repos.summary_zh: 为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码 Agent 提供技能、记忆、安全与性能优化的通用增强框架

repos.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
repos.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repos.summary_zh: 单文件CLAUDE.md提炼Karpathy对LLM编码陷阱的观察，直接改善Claude Code行为

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用的模块化能力，让 Agent 快速掌握专业任务执行方法

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: stalwartlabs/stalwart
repos.description: All-in-one Mail & Collaboration server. Secure, scalable and fluent in every protocol (IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV, WebDAV).
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的一体化邮件与协作服务器，安全可扩展且原生支持 IMAP、JMAP、SMTP、CalDAV、CardDAV、WebDAV 全协议

repos.name: AienTech/dossier
repos.description: A self-hosted job search app that writes tailored resumes and cover letters from your profile.
repos.summary_zh: 自托管求职助手，根据个人档案自动生成定制简历和求职信，一站式追踪职位申请进度

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的高性能多线程 Redis/Valkey 替代品，可直接替换且内置全文与向量检索

repos.name: cdcailf/cjkfold
repos.description: Fold look-alike CJK glyphs (Kangxi radicals, CJK radical supplements) so text extracted from PDFs matches again.
repos.summary_zh: 专治 PDF 提取文本中康熙部首等 CJK 形近字不匹配问题，用 NFKC 折叠让中文检索和 NLP 处理重新对齐

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant
repos.summary_zh: 为 AI Agent 提供跨会话持久记忆，自动捕获会话内容并用 AI 压缩，再将相关上下文注入后续会话

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费LLM供应商共635个模型端点于单一/v1接口，支持智能路由、自动故障转移与密钥加密，月享74亿token

repos.name: google/brotli
repos.description: Brotli compression format
repos.summary_zh: 谷歌开源的高压缩比无损压缩算法，比 gzip 更小更快，专为网页传输优化

repos.name: trymirai/uzu
repos.description: A high-performance inference engine for AI models
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 AI 模型推理引擎，主打极致速度与低资源占用

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: FrontiersMindAI/decisionformer
repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让任意 Hugging Face 模型一键微调、加载并部署为校准决策模型，把 Transformer 直接变成可用的决策引擎

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面工具，可自建服务器替代 TeamViewer，用 Rust 编写兼顾性能与安全

repos.name: ghostty-org/ghostty
repos.description: 👻 Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich, and cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Zig 编写、GPU 加速且跨平台的终端模拟器，以原生 UI 兼顾速度与丰富功能

repos.name: cjpais/Handy
repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: 完全离线运行的免费开源语音转文字应用，用 Rust 打造且支持扩展

repos.name: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover
repos.description: A privacy-first app that strips AI watermarks from content you own.
repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的AI水印去除工具，帮你清除自有内容中的AI水印，已获2.5万星

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: ruvnet/RuView
repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel
repos.summary_zh: 用普通WiFi信号实现实时空间感知、生命体征监测与存在检测，无需任何摄像头画面

repos.name: remotion-dev/remotion
repos.description: 🎥 Make videos programmatically with React
repos.summary_zh: 用 React 组件像写网页一样编程生成视频，让开发者以熟悉的声明式方式实现视频自动化制作

repos.name: HKUDS/DeepTutor
repos.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.
repos.summary_zh: 港大开源的可终身个性化辅导的AI导师，能记住你的学习轨迹并持续适配教学节奏

repos.name: lfnovo/open-notebook
repos.description: An Open Source implementation of Notebook LM with more flexibility and features
repos.summary_zh: 开源版 Notebook LM，比原版更灵活、功能更丰富，可自建 AI 笔记与研究助手

papers.summary_zh: 提出先提议后过滤再释放的私有过滤框架，将噪声从最坏情况单记录影响降至典型敏感度，显著提升估计精度

papers.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated
papers.summary_zh: 提出离散扩散模型的概率流ODE采样器，实现确定性采样并支持加速与一致性蒸馏

papers.title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
papers.abstract: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys,
papers.summary_zh: 提出Copula混合与无记忆竞争的无失真水印，在投机解码下保持令牌水印与接受率不变并维持输出多样性

papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
papers.abstract: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, ma
papers.summary_zh: 提出解耦数据集属性的LM数据归因评估框架，可隔离归因算法失败原因并揭示设计空间关键因素

papers.title: Multistatic ISAC with Deep Learning-Based Clutter Suppression for 5G and Beyond
papers.abstract: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems using 5G and beyond signals of opportunity enable joint wireless sensing and communication using shared infrastructure and spectrum resources. Whil
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于深度学习的多基地ISAC杂波抑制方法，利用5G及未来信号实现共享基础设施的联合感知与通信并提升密集动态环境下的感知覆盖

papers.title: From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
papers.abstract: Extreme weather is forecast days ahead, yet its consequences for agriculture remain hard to predict: a forecast says where a storm will strike, not which crops will suffer or how much is at risk, and
papers.summary_zh: 提出首个面向极端天气农业影响的智能体WxCrop，融合多源记录实现作物风险评估

papers.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
papers.abstract: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems
papers.summary_zh: 提出多智能体协作框架实现固态量子自旋实验全流程自主研究，通过证据约束推理避免无依据结论

papers.title: Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In
papers.abstract: When AI agents share channels and credentials, one agent can press another to break its operator's rule, a first step towards collusion. Output filters check only what an agent has already written. Ca
papers.summary_zh: 提出在智能体即将屈服前用线性探针预判其违规倾向，实现提前预警而非事后过滤

papers.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
papers.abstract: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer det
papers.summary_zh: 提出读分配路由角色耦合令牌化方法，让像素空间生成Transformer按细节需求动态分配令牌并路由全局通信，显著降低注意力开销

papers.title: Adaptive Scenario Generation for KL-DRO Around a Learned Density Model
papers.abstract: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) hedges data-driven two-stage stochastic programs against error in the distribution estimated from a finite record, and standard ambiguity sets differ in how
papers.summary_zh: 提出围绕学习密度模型自适应生成场景的KL-DRO方法，突破经验分布零密度限制，提升有限样本下的鲁棒决策性能

papers.title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
papers.abstract: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (los
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向真实场景的行李重识别策略研究，系统评估多种ReID方法在监控视频中的性能并给出应用部署建议

papers.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
papers.abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This br
papers.summary_zh: 提出利用浅层安全对齐机制构建多轮防御器，将多轮攻击成功率显著降低并揭示对齐浅层性是脆弱性根源

papers.title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
papers.abstract: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce

papers.abstract: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh: 提出无需奖励信号直接从观测学习潜在动力学的世界模型方法world2vec，实现机制可解释的世界建模

papers.title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
papers.abstract: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于时间线证据的临床时序假设显著性检验框架，为语言模型断言提供统计检验支撑而非仅凭流畅表述
